company_description:
Achievers Resource Solutions are recruitment professionals who aim to go beyond expectations for both clients and candidates. We know that the future of any company is shaped by its people and getting the 'people fit'​ right makes all the difference.  We place the right person with the right job in the right company. 

We have been around the block – we have seen recessions and good times come and go. And we know how to recruit and manage people for both. Collectively we have a great many years’ experience in the recruitment business across many and varied industries.

For Job seekers – Think the Right Fit…

The most important thing to job seekers is finding the right job in the right environment. That is why we spend time getting to know you. We look at more than just your CV and qualifications, we are interested in your personality, skills, drive and vision.  The Achievers Resource Solutions’ way is to take the ‘whole person’ into consideration.  We call it ‘people fit’.

For Employers – Think partnership…

We see ourselves as an extension of our clients’ organisations.  We believe we can play an integral role in the strategic growth of your business. We explore not just the position that needs filling but also the culture of the organisation. We look at the full mix of what is working for you now with your current staff and what skills, expertise and personalities you will need to build and grow your company into the future. The right partner delivers the best results.

A comprehensive list of jobs we are currently recruiting for is available at www.achievers.ie/jobs-list

BRINGING SOFT SKILLS TO THE FOREFRONT OF RECRUITING

What is EQ? EQ or Emotional Quotient is a common term for how emotional intelligence is measured. There are many different traits that make up emotional intelligence, but generally it's one’s ability to understand, empathize, and negotiate with other people.

At EQ Recruiting we believe that emotional intelligence is one of the most important parts of the interview process and is one of the main things lacking in recruiting today. We put a heavy emphasis on relationships, culture, fit, and team with both the candidates and companies we work with.

At EQ, we take the time to personally vet each candidate and get to know them on an emotional and professional level.  We specialize in engineering and sales roles, but have contacts in every space! We believe relationships are everything, and whether you're an organization needing strategic guidance or a person who simply needs job search advice, we are here to help!

company_description:
At RogueHire, our mission is to empower healthcare organizations to identify, engage, and recruit talented professionals dedicated to serving their communities.

We proudly offer the industry's first Healthcare Recruitment Operating System (rOS), a software solution that leverages Decision Intelligence (DI) analytics, industry benchmarks, and advanced methodologies to enhance the performance of your talent acquisition (TA) organization.

Additionally, our Rogue Healthcare Community (HCC) stands as the largest inclusive network for healthcare talent acquisition professionals, providing a trusted space to connect, share, learn, and grow collaboratively.

company_description:
Brick House Recruitment partners with SaaS and B2B growth-stage teams to build sales functions that scale without breaking.

We don’t just fill roles.

We fix misalignment.

Most sales hiring failures aren’t caused by a lack of talent.

They happen because:

• The role is oversold
• Lead flow doesn’t match expectations
• Compensation creates the wrong incentives
• Onboarding lacks structure
• Fulfillment weakens rep confidence
• Hiring is reactive instead of strategic

The result?

High turnover.
Slow ramp-up.
Revenue instability.
Damaged employer reputation.

We work with founders, CROs, and sales leaders who are actively scaling SDR, BDR, and AE teams — and want hires that perform and stay.

Our approach focuses on:

✔ Revenue alignment
✔ Cultural precision
✔ Long-term retention
✔ Clear role architecture
✔ Sales system stability

Because every hire reshapes your company.

And growth without structural clarity doesn’t compound.

If you’re building a sales team and want alignment over hype — we should talk.

company_description:
Scout Therapy Staffing is a clinician-owned travel therapy staffing agency built by therapists, for therapists. Founded by experienced travel physical therapists, Scout was created to redefine the staffing experience through transparency, higher pay, and genuine support.
We specialize in connecting top-tier Physical Therapists (PTs), Occupational Therapists (OTs), and Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs) with high-quality travel opportunities across the United States—while helping healthcare facilities secure reliable, skilled professionals.
At Scout, we believe travel therapy should be more than just a job—it should be an opportunity to grow, explore, and earn more. That’s why we focus on:
• Clinician-first approach — every decision prioritizes the therapist experience
• Higher, transparent compensation — no hidden numbers, no surprises
• Real relationships — not transactions, but long-term partnerships
• Expert-driven recruiting — led by clinicians who understand the field
• Seamless onboarding & support — from first contact to assignment completion
Our mission is simple: to improve the travel therapy experience by putting clinicians first while delivering reliable staffing solutions to healthcare organizations.
With a strong network and a growing presence in the industry, Scout continues to empower therapists to earn more, travel further, and find roles where they truly thrive.

title: Senior Managing Director
company_products_services: legal, recruiting
company_description:
At RPN, we understand that the most effective placements begin with learning the individual needs of every client we serve. Our experienced team will take the time to listen to your strategy and design a unique placement plan that aligns with your specific goals.
Once we understand your needs, we'll lead the process to locate candidates and identify opportunities to fulfill each client's strategy.
Relationship based recruiting saves time. By knowing our clients and meeting all candidates presented, every interview that RPN schedules is potentially a strong fit.

Prior to establishing RPN, Steve Rado, Lee Presser, and Rachel Newman worked together for a combined 40 years as legal recruiters. Individually and as a team we have helped hundreds of attorneys make positive career moves. We have also established and managed client relationships with corporations spanning all industries, law firms of all sizes, and not-for-profits. At RPN, we take tremendous pride in being relationship based recruiters, not simply transactional, and the result of this approach is that the vast majority of our new clients are referred to us by existing clients.

We know that some see this approach as too traditional. Others suggest that there are faster ways available, like sending resumes without meeting the candidate and using outsourced recruiters to speed the acquisition of candidates.
